text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's see my weight...――!?
...N-No way... Did I... gain weight...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Why...?
Ah... could these treats be from an upperclassman...?

text_block_list.name: Shion's Senior
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Sion. Working hard late into the night again, I see.
Looks pretty tough. If you're going to keep going,
eat this and recharge your energy!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...It was so sweet of them, so I took it.
And then after that, the upperclassmen brought treats every single day.
...I really ate way too much, huh."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, I have to lose weight! To keep my running sharp and prevent any loss of speed...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I'm startin' right away tomorrow!
...That special diet menu my dad taught me!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Brown rice, chicken tenderloin, and tofu miso soup.
...Yeah, with this low-calorie menu,
I should be able to lose weight even with my usual portion size.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Plus, fresh tomatoes and cabbage! Vitamins and minerals are essential for glowing skin, after all!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "Ballet dancers lose weight healthily." ...My father used to say that a lot.

text_block_list.name: Shion's Father
text_block_list.text: Listen, Shion. You can't dance "beautiful" ballet without being healthy. True beauty radiates from within the dancer.

text_block_list.name: Shion's Father
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why your daily meals are so important.
Pushing yourself too hard with your diet isn't good for your body either.
If there's something you want to eat, just be honest and tell me.

text_block_list.name: Young Sion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it! I'll eat all of Dad's food
and become the star of the show too!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Right, eating properly is a form of effort too.
I'll manage my diet carefully and get my weight back!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Well then, thank you for the meal!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Win Variation continued the meal plan taught by her father and successfully achieved a healthy diet.
